mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days without regime dependency.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.2 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.2pp, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in residential investment (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates strong consumer confidence and housing market activity that drives corporate revenue growth, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when both RSAFS and HOUST rise, or interaction term Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a high unemployment regime (UNRATE > 5.5%), rising industrial production (INDPRO) signals manufacturing sector recovery that precedes economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE > 5.5 and INDPRO rises, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly federal funds rate increase exceeding 0.1 percentage points signals imminent monetary tightening that raises borrowing costs and reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS rises > 0.1pp, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) indicates strengthening labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days without regime dependency.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS rises, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a low inflation regime (CPIAUCSL < 235.0), rising residential investment (RSAFS) signals robust household spending that boosts corporate revenue growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL < 235.0 and RSAFS rises, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly industrial production decline exceeding 0.5 percentage points signals manufacturing sector contraction that reduces corporate output and earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO falls > 0.5pp, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
